metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and this poor soul just vanished? Valorant logic at it again
metadata.description:
Tapping like I wasn’t even trying

Did NOT deserve that accidental scare but hey, free chaos!
Click if your aim’s mostly accidental magic too!

Tap if your aim’s 90% accident and 10% pure luck!
